release_gates.name: Zero Committed Secrets and Clean Client Bundle
release_gates.description: No private API keys, service role tokens, or internal secrets in repository or client bundle.

release_gates.name: Cross-User RLS Data Isolation
release_gates.description: User A cannot read or modify User B alerts, bookmarks, or preferences. Anon reads are restricted.

release_gates.name: Strict Currency and Monetary Precision
release_gates.description: Prices must be positive finite numbers. No zero/negative fares allowed in ingestion or feed.

release_gates.name: No False Freshness
release_gates.description: Observations older than 120m are never presented as healthy fresh. Stale deals carry explicit recheck warnings.

release_gates.name: AI Output Grounding / Deterministic Truth Dominance
release_gates.description: AI must never fabricate flight facts, prices, or schedules. Schema validation and rule-based fallback enforced.

release_gates.name: Self-Transfer and Risk Disclosure Invariant
release_gates.description: Separate-ticket journeys must never be mislabeled as protected connections. Layover buffers strictly checked.

release_gates.name: Quarantine for Extreme Outliers with Low Sample Size
release_gates.description: Extreme price drops with n<3 cannot trigger top alerts or be labeled 'Deal cực nóng'. Confidence gating enforced.

release_gates.name: Notification Spam Prevention and 24h Deduplication
release_gates.description: Notification dispatch enforces effectively-once semantics with 24h deduplication per user/route.

release_gates.name: Clean Migration Chain Reproducibility
release_gates.description: All 38 migrations apply sequentially on clean PostgreSQL without schema drift.

release_gates.name: Production Build & Typecheck Integrity
release_gates.description: Zero TypeScript errors, zero ESLint warnings, production build succeeds cleanly.

release_gates.name: Critical End-to-End User Flow Execution
release_gates.description: All 32 Playwright E2E tests execute cleanly on desktop and mobile viewports.
